rows.grounds: compound of vāma (left), ācāra (practice), and ratā (devoted)
compound of aṇimā+ādi (beginning with aṇimā), aṣṭa (eight), siddhi (powers), and dā (giver)

items.question: What status and powers belong to one devoted to left-hand practice?
premises: She is devoted to left-hand practice.
She is indeed worthy of worship.
She grants the eight powers beginning with aṇimā.
items.inference: Therefore, devotion to left-hand practice confers worship-worthiness and the capacity to bestow the eight powers.
items.plain_english: Devoted to the left-hand practice, she is indeed worthy of worship and grants the eight powers beginning with aṇimā.
